Docket 1.3.109

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A first look while the audit is still running.* The window used to show a progress
  bar until the whole audit ended, about a minute on a site of 150 pages. After the
  first 25 pages Docket now runs its checks on what it has read so far and shows a
  score, how many problems it has found, and the most important one by name, in a card
  that says it is from the first pages and can change. The crawl carries on behind it.
  On the free copy the card shows only what the free result shows: the score, the
  count and the one problem. In testing on a 152-page site the first look arrived after
  about 10 seconds and the finished audit after about 57. The finished audit is the
  same as before: the first look works on a copy, and a test runs an audit both ways
  and compares every finding.

99 checks across 13 areas.
